_note: Filling a node's spare cores: four GPU tasks hold 8 cores each on their own CPU (site default --gpu-cores 8 --numa); the pool takes the rest. cmd_file has one shell command per line; 'parallel' workers, each pinned to 'threads' cores, run the lines in stride order at nice 10; every command's exit code and seconds are logged, and a failed command fails the node's all_ok. Keep pool outputs on scratch.
